items.title: Yusef Lateef — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was working at the Waldorf Astoria in the band, orchestra behind Johnny Mathis

ctx.x: And...but um one time I was trying to decide whether I should be a studio musician, ‘cause I was getting quite a bit of work. I was working at the Waldorf Astoria in the band, orchestra behind Johnny Mathis, et cetera, but then I decided I didn’t want to do that. I had, I thought I had something personal I wanted to express, so I kind of moved away from that.
Were you continuing to uh...to work on your own composition at, at this time, as well?
